summary_en: JPY 27 per share interim dividend (up JPY 2 from prior guidance) and JPY 48 per share year-end dividend (up JPY 4) announced, bringing total annual dividend to JPY 75 per share, reflecting upward revision of FY2027 earnings guidance with operating profit upgraded to JPY 9,200 million.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 and Revision (Dividend Increase) of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecasts
translation_en_brief:
Jecos announced on November 5, 2026 a revision of its full-year earnings forecast and dividend guidance for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend has been increased to JPY 27 per share from the previously guided JPY 25 per share, while the year-end dividend has been raised to JPY 48 per share from JPY 44 per share, bringing the total annual dividend to JPY 75 per share. The interim period (April–September 2026) performance in the temporary construction business exceeded expectations due to solid project progress and cost improvement initiatives.

The full-year consolidated earnings forecast was revised upward with operating profit increased to JPY 9.2 billion (from JPY 8.4 billion), ordinary profit to JPY 9.6 billion (from JPY 8.6 billion), and net profit attributable to parent shareholders to JPY 6.3 billion (from JPY 5.7 billion). The year-end dividend increase of JPY 4 reflects the upward earnings revision and is consistent with the company's stated dividend policy of a payout ratio of approximately 40% and a DOE (dividend on equity) of 2.5% or higher as outlined in the medium-term management plan for 2025–2027. The interim dividend with record date of September 30, 2026 becomes effective on December 1, 2026.
